contract.selection: Optional Discord Integer page, minimum 1; omitted page is byte-identical to explicit page 1.
contract.metadata: Nonempty replies contain Page N of M; every nonfinal page names /command-list page:NEXT. No required page-size choice.
contract.rows: Complete /name (or !trigger) — on|off lines, in ascending name order, exactly once across all pages; slash-only and disabled commands remain visible.
contract.limit: The entire response, including page metadata and navigation, is at most 2000 UTF-16 units.
contract.empty: No custom commands defined. stays byte-identical for omitted page and page 1; page 2 refuses.
contract.refusal: Invalid types, duplicate page, zero, negative, integer extremes and out-of-range pages produce an ephemeral refusal of at most 300 UTF-16 units naming page, /command-list and a valid starting page/range; never echo malformed input or silently serve rows.
contract.invariants: Existing ManageGuild/feature/application/guild fences, disabled-only discovery, mention suppression, one acknowledgement plus at most one completion, no command/timestamp/audit mutation, no registry publication on list.
contract.renderer_compatibility: Keep format_command_list(&[StoredCommand]) callable for page one. Later-page implementation API is unconstrained; gateway tests use actual packet options.
contract.unicode_fixture: Astral names are defensive pure-renderer inputs only, not a claim that non-ASCII command names are legal. Gateway fixtures use 49 legal 32-character names and 33-character triggers.
